name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $4,068 on 11 Nov, down 8.3% over three months, just past the 8% fall that marks Watch
state: Gold futures were near $4,068 early on 11 Nov, 8.3% lower over three months and 1.1% lower on the week, just beyond the 8% three-month fall that marks Watch (Yahoo Finance). The price is about 24% below its 52-week high of $5,318. No single-week move approaches the 7% Alert line.
for_you: Gold has fallen sharply from its peak. Holders of gold or gold funds have seen values drop over recent months.
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
